history.title: Journal
history.intro: Find the consumption events, support sessions, and daily check-ins you chose to record, grouped by date.
history.error: The journal could not be loaded.

empty.title: Your journal is still empty
empty.body: Consumption events and check-ins you record will appear here.

delete.title: Delete this entry?
delete.consumption: This entry and its private note will be permanently removed from your journal. Your statistics will be recalculated without it.
delete.checkIn: This daily check-in and its private note will be permanently removed from your journal. Your statistics will be recalculated without it.
delete.urge: This support session and the reflection written at the end will be permanently removed. The strategy tried during it stops counting; a consumption event recorded from it is kept.

error.delete: This entry could not be deleted. Nothing was changed.
